extracted.intended_audience: researchers in basic biological and biomedical sciences seeking HHMI funding (PhD–senior faculty)
extracted.subtask_description: Overview guidance for researchers seeking HHMI support: which career stages and program competitions exist, basic eligibility considerations, and how HHMI selects grantees. Directs applicants to program pages for program-specific requirements and application procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research field eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: HHMI scientific research programs are open to researchers in basic biological and biomedical sciences in many scientific disciplines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programs target work in basic biological and biomedical sciences across many disciplines; applicants should confirm their research fits within these fields via the specific program page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institutional affiliation / geographic scope
rubrics_metrics.description: Programs are open to researchers at hundreds of institutions across the US.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants are expected to be based at U.S. institutions (or institutions represented among those HHMI works with); check individual program pages for any additional institutional eligibility details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Career-stage alignment
rubrics_metrics.description: HHMI offers career-stage–targeted support: PhD, Postdoc, Early Career, Faculty, Mid-Career & Senior Faculty, and named fellowships (e.g., Gilliam, Hanna Gray, Freeman Hrabowski, Investigators).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should apply to programs that match their current career stage; program pages list which stages are eligible and any stage-specific requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Competition frequency / timing
rubrics_metrics.description: Competitions occur on defined schedules (e.g., Gilliam Fellows — Annual; Hanna Gray Fellows — every 2 years; Freeman Hrabowski Scholars — every 2 years; Investigators — every 5 years).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use stated competition frequency to plan when to prepare or expect calls for applications; timing and rounds differ by program.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program-specific objectives and eligibility criteria
rubrics_metrics.description: HHMI selects researchers and grantees through competitions that have specific objectives and eligibility criteria; information about eligibility requirements and how to apply for specific programs can be found on each program’s page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each program has its own stated objectives and detailed eligibility rules — applicants must review the individual program page for precise criteria rather than relying on the general overview.

rubrics_metrics.name: No unsolicited proposals / formal invitation and review process
rubrics_metrics.description: HHMI does not review or fund unsolicited grant proposals. Most HHMI grants competitions have a formal invitation and review process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prospective applicants should not submit unsolicited proposals; instead, follow the application/invitation procedures for each competition as described on the program pages.
